statement: The cognitive-complexity ratchet passes at no more than its 179-violation baseline and the cyclomatic-complexity ratchet passes at no more than its 1847-violation baseline, achieved solely by behavior-preserving reduction of real violations with neither baseline raised; the duplication, circular-dependency, unused-export, and file-size ratchets do not regress; and the test files exercising every touched source owner remain green.
